procedure_text: 环磺酮制备方法，其特征在于，包括如下的任意一个步骤： 根据权利要求1所述的方法，其中所述步骤(v)和(v′)分别为以下步骤： 根据权利要求2所述的方法，其中步骤(v-1)或(v′-1)的反应在贵金属催化剂和磷配体或其盐存在下进行，所述贵金属选自钯、铑、钌、铜、钴，优选钯催化剂，更优选氯化钯(PdCl2)、碳酸钯(PdCO3)、醋酸钯[Pd(OAc)2]、钯/碳(Pd/C)、三氟乙酸钯[Pd(OTFA)2]、双二亚苄基丙酮钯[Pd(dba)2]； 所述磷配体或其盐优选为1,3-(双二苯基膦)丙烷、1,4-双(二苯基膦)丁烷或者双[(4-N,N-二甲氨基)苯基]二叔丁基膦。 根据权利要求3所述的方法，其中反应溶剂是选自甲苯、1,4-二氧六环、乙二醇二甲醚、乙二醇二乙醚、二甲基亚砜(DMSO)、四氢呋喃(THF)、N,N-二甲基甲酰胺(DMF)中的一种或两种以上。
procedure_summary: The aryl bromide bearing the trifluoroethoxymethyl and methanesulfonyl groups is carbonylated with carbon monoxide and water over a noble metal catalyst and a phosphine ligand to give the corresponding benzoic acid.
notes: Claim 1 recites the process as any one of the drawn steps; the arrow at line 555 is this one, drawn bare, and claim 2 respecifies it at line 561 with CO and H2O on the arrow and calls it step (v-1). The bare (v) and the specified (v-1) are the same transformation, so they are one record and not two. Classification choice, applied consistently across this section and the other of the two sections re-run together (Claims and Summary of the Invention): all four carbonylation arrows in these sections, steps (v) and (v') and the first arrow of each of (vi) and (vi'), are classed other_cross_coupling with mechanism catalytic. The enum has no carbonylation term. The defining event in all four is insertion of carbon monoxide into a metal-aryl bond formed from the same aryl bromide, and the acid and ester variants differ only in the nucleophile that traps the acyl-metal species, so splitting them between two classes would make one transformation look like two. This run's registry already uses other_cross_coupling for the same transformation in Example 6, Example 9 and Example 11 and in Preparation Routes and General Embodiments::Step 7; it uses other in Example 7 and ester_formation in Preparation Routes and General Embodiments::Step 8. Those readings are recorded here as the alternatives not taken. The catalyst, ligand and solvent lists come from dependent claims 3 and 4, which apply to step (v-1) or (v'-1); they are alternatives from a claimed list, not a charge, and they are not drawn on the claim 2 arrow, which is ordinary claim structure and not a conflict. Document order puts this step first in the section even though it is fifth in the route. Step count: A0 estimated 8 steps for this section and this pass emits 12. No new transformation was found. The difference is arrow granularity: composite step (vi) is drawn as four arrows and composite step (vi') as two, and rule 5d asks for one record per drawn arrow, so those two schemes are no longer collapsed into one record each. Recording them collapsed lost the benzoic acid, the acid chloride and the enol ester as separately claimed intermediates.
